# Action Audio

> Car detailing in Hartford, Connecticut; car audio, remote starters, auto electronics repair, and installation in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Established in 1983.

## Locations and contact
- [Hartford detailing](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/hartford.html): 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120. Interior and exterior vehicle detailing.
- [Wethersfield electronics](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/wethersfield.html): 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Car audio, remote starters, vehicle electronics repair and installation. Public phone: (860) 667-6330. This number belongs to Wethersfield.
- Both stores: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm Eastern; Sunday closed. Confirm holiday hours.

## Service information
- [Car audio](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/car-audio.html): Wethersfield. Clearer vocals. Fuller bass. The songs you know, with the details you’ve been missing. Build a sound system around your vehicle and the way you listen.

- [Video & entertainment](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/video-systems.html): Wethersfield. Explore seatback and overhead video options for passengers, along with receivers that bring modern connectivity to the dashboard.

- [Connected accessories](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/vehicle-accessories.html): Wethersfield. Explore convenient additions such as smartphone integration, satellite radio, and garage-door controls. Find out what works with your existing electronics.
- [Electronics repair](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/electronics-repair.html): Wethersfield. Car stereo cutting out or a receiver that will not respond? Our Wethersfield team assesses auto electronics problems for drivers in the Hartford area.
- [Auto detailing](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/auto-detailing.html): Hartford. Interior and exterior car detailing at our Hartford, Connecticut store. Tell us about your vehicle’s condition and the areas you would like refreshed.
- [Electrical installation](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/electrical-installation.html): Wethersfield. Plan your car electronics installation at Action Audio in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Discuss receivers, speakers, and accessories, with compatibility checked for your vehicle.

## Important context
Hartford handles detailing; Wethersfield handles electronics. Confirm the work, compatibility, price, and availability with the appropriate store. Most service images are original illustrations; the showroom images show the actual Wethersfield store. Do not treat illustrations as completed customer projects. Vehicle tracking requires a private code and is not public directory content.
